* [[2008 Chinese winter storms]]: [[Premier of the People's Republic of China|Chinese Premier]] [[Wen Jiabao]] visits disaster-affected region in [[Guizhou]] Province, one of the worst-hit provinces, to direct relief efforts. This is his third trip to disaster regions in eight days. [http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/2008-02/05/content_6444291.htm (China Daily)]
* A [[2008 Super Tuesday tornado outbreak|major tornado outbreak]] across the [[Southern United States]] leaves 57 people dead, and causes some polling places to be closed early. The hardest hit areas are in Alabama, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi, and Arkansas, including the [[Memphis metropolitan area|Memphis area]], northern [[Middle Tennessee]] and [[Jackson, Tennessee]]. [http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/23006771/ (MSNBC)] [https://news.yahoo.com/s/ap/20080206/ap_on_re_us/severe_weather (AP via Yahoo! News)]
